question.text: In $\mathrm{XeF}_2, \mathrm{XeF}_4, \mathrm{XeF}_6$ the numebr of lone pairs of $\mathrm{Xe}$ are respectively

solution.text: $\begin{array}{lll}\mathrm{XeF}_2 & \mathrm{sp}^3 \mathrm{~d} & 3 \text { lone pairs } \\ \mathrm{XeF}_4 & \mathrm{sp}^3 \mathrm{~d}^2 & 2 \text { lone pairs } \\ \mathrm{XeF}_6 & \mathrm{sp}^3 \mathrm{~d}^3 & \text { 1 lone pair }\end{array}$
